findings.quote: Who This Is Not For: Wave Advisors provides dedicated bookkeeping services starting from $149 to $199 per month...
findings.problem: The required section contains no exclusion (who the alternatives or Wave do not fit); it is just Wave Advisors pricing.
findings.fix: Rewrite with who Wave and each alternative do not fit, e.g. businesses needing inventory, multi-user permissions or per-client caps.

findings.problem: monotone-rhythm: sentences 25-29 have lengths [12,13,12,12,15], within 3 words of each other.

findings.quote: Choose QuickBooks Online if your operation requires inventory management...; Select Xero if you need...; Opt for Zoho Books...; pick Bonsai if you want...
findings.problem: Imperative recommendations are advice framing; the adapter allows only "fits people who...".
findings.fix: Rewrite as "QuickBooks Online fits businesses that..."; same for the next-action sentence's "compare..." if it reads as advice.

findings.quote: Free $0 for 1 user and 1 accountant. (Zoho row); Its Free plan costs $0 per month for 1 user and 1 accountant
findings.problem: Zoho's pricing FAQ limits the Free plan to revenue under $50K per financial year and 1,000 invoices and 1,000 expenses per year. The page contrasts it with Wave's unlimited invoicing without the cap.
findings.fix: State the $50K revenue and 1,000 invoices per year limits.

findings.quote: Growing ... adding automated bill entry, a 60-day cash flow forecast and free ACH for domestic bill payments; Growing removes billing caps and includes free Automated Clearing House (ACH) domestic bill payments
findings.problem: Xero's Early plan also lists "Make online bill payments (Domestic - Free ACH)"; free ACH is not an upgrade at Growing. Xero's page says "quotes and 20 invoices", while the page says 20 invoices, quotes.
findings.fix: Remove ACH as a Growing differentiator; say Early allows quotes and 20 invoices per month and 5 bills.

findings.quote: QuickBooks Online, FreshBooks, Xero, Zoho Books and Bonsai are five Wave alternatives, with entry prices running from $0 free plans to QuickBooks Simple Start at $38 per month. ... At The Modern Wallet, we show the arithmetic behind accounting software...
findings.problem: Opener is a 31-word sentence with a garbled price range (Simple Start is not the top entry price and $0 free plans is unclear); third sentence is an unsupported first-person tee-up and the intro is three sentences.
findings.fix: Shorten sentence 1 to a plain answer; delete or neutralise the tee-up.

findings.quote: Invoicing, payments, contracts, proposals, scheduling, client portals and expense tracking unlock at the Essentials tier.
Xero fits businesses that need bank reconciliation and cash flow forecasting. Wave charges $19 per month on Pro to access user permissions...
findings.problem: Alternatives sections repeat the table's bestFit line verbatim and contain a few unclear one-liners; Wave Pro Amex 3.4% + $0 and the $9.50 promo are omitted.
findings.fix: Replace repeats with fresh specifics; add Amex rate.
